'''Garsi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] guard of the [[Galactic Justice Center]] and a guard in the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]. Along with [[Wyrlan]], Garsi guarded [[Ben Skywalker]] as [[Tahiri Veila]] tortured [[Lon Shevu]] to [[Death/Legends|death]] in front of them. Both he and Wyrlan willingly let Skywalker escape after he stunned Veila with their weapons and threatened them with death if they didn't let him leave.
